name: London Ambulance Service
description:
The London Ambulance Service dispatches ambulances in emergencies. The key goal is to allocate an available ambulance for every call that can reach the scene within 11 minutes. The entire dispatch process must not exceed a set maximum time limit.

To make this work, the Computer Aided Despatch system analyzes incident forms and assigns vehicles. It is vital to track the exact location of moving ambulances. This requires ambulance staff to follow standard routes and correctly communicate departure and destination information, allowing radio operators and the CAD system to record data accurately.
rawDescription:
The London Ambulance Service dispatches ambulances in emergencies. The key goal is to allocate an available ambulance for every call that can reach the scene within 11 minutes. The entire dispatch process must not exceed a set maximum time limit.

To make this work, the Computer Aided Despatch system analyzes incident forms and assigns vehicles. It is vital to track the exact location of moving ambulances. This requires ambulance staff to follow standard routes and correctly communicate departure and destination information, allowing radio operators and the CAD system to record data accurately.
highLevelGoals: Minimize response time to ensure every emergency call is reached within 11 minutes.
Record precise departure and destination information to support efficient resource allocation.
Track the exact location of ambulances in motion to optimize routing and response.
Allow emergency callers to quickly report incidents and initiate the dispatch process.
lowLevelGoals: The Dispatcher assigns an available ambulance to an emergency call within 11 minutes of call receipt.
The Radio Operator logs the exact departure time and GPS coordinates of the assigned ambulance.
The Radio Operator logs the destination address and arrival time of the ambulance at the scene.
The Ambulance Driver sends GPS coordinates to the system every 30 seconds while en route.
The Emergency Caller dials the emergency number and triggers the system to log the incident details.
The Emergency Caller submits location, nature of emergency, and contact information via the system interface.

Together, these LLGs define a complete operational scope for dispatching, data recording, and real-time tracking of ambulances using a CAD system, with no omitted or generalized functionality.

hlg_173e70b446c0ce36_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Dispatch and monitor emergency ambulance responses by assigning vehicles to calls within strict time constraints, recording standardized operational data, and tracking real-time vehicle locations along predefined routes using a Computer Aided Despatch system.
hlg_173e70b446c0ce36_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to assign ambulances to emergency calls with a strict 11-minute response window via system-enforced constraints. llg_002 adds the capability to record standardized departure and destination data from ambulance crews using radio protocols and integrate it into the CAD system. llg_003 adds the capability to track ambulance locations in real-time along standard routes to enable optimal routing and response monitoring. Together, these LLGs define a complete operational scope for dispatching, data recording, and real-time tracking of ambulances using a CAD system, with no omitted or generalized functionality.

hlg_6ba20cb10b0d20a0_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Log the complete operational timeline and geographic trace of each assigned ambulance from departure to arrival at the scene.
hlg_6ba20cb10b0d20a0_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to record the departure time and location (GPS coordinates) of the ambulance, establishing the start point of its operational timeline. llg_002 adds the capability to record the destination address and arrival time, establishing the endpoint of the operational timeline. Together, they define a complete geographic and temporal trace of the ambulance’s movement, with no implicit or inferred operations beyond these two distinct logging actions.

hlg_be971399c23d5fec_001.rationale: llg_001 specifies that the Ambulance Driver must send GPS coordinates every 30 seconds while en route, which directly defines the requirement for real-time, periodic location updates. No other LLGs are provided, so the reconstructed goal must fully capture this singular capability without inference or generalization.

hlg_173e70b446c0ce36_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Dispatch and monitor emergency ambulance responses by assigning vehicles to calls within strict time constraints, recording standardized operational data, and tracking real-time vehicle locations along predefined routes using a Computer Aided Despatch system.
hlg_173e70b446c0ce36_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to assign ambulances to emergency calls with a strict 11-minute response window via system-enforced constraints. llg_002 adds the capability to record standardized departure and destination data from ambulance crews using radio protocols and integrate it into the CAD system. llg_003 adds the capability to track ambulance locations in real-time along standard routes to enable optimal routing and response monitoring. Together, these LLGs define a complete operational scope for dispatching, data recording, and real-time tracking of ambulances using a CAD system, with no omitted or generalized functionality.

hlg_6ba20cb10b0d20a0_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to record the departure time and location (GPS coordinates) of the ambulance, establishing the start point of its operational timeline. llg_002 adds the capability to record the destination address and arrival time, establishing the endpoint of the operational timeline. Together, they define a complete geographic and temporal trace of the ambulance’s movement, with no implicit or inferred operations beyond these two distinct logging actions.

hlg_be971399c23d5fec_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time GPS updates during transit; llg_002 adds route compliance logging via pre-defined paths; llg_003 adds departure time and location reporting to CAD; llg_004 adds arrival time and location reporting to CAD.
